content.title: Coachella YouTube set times revealed: Everything to know for Couchella
content.text: Thu, April 9, 2026 at 11:01 PM CDTUS singer Sabrina Carpenter performs on the Coachella Stage during the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival in Indio, California, on April 12, 2024.Coachella is here, which means for everyone who can't make it out to the Southern California desert this weekend, Couchella is just a livestream away.The festival will stream for free on YouTube at youtube.com/coachella. It will unfold on seven different channels, each focusing on a different stage, with three channels — Coachella Stage, Outdoor Theatre and Sahara — streaming in 4K.Festival producers have unveiled the set times for this weekend's streams, which include weekend headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G.The livestream kicks off at 7 p.m. eastern time on Friday.
